y axis to represent the

## Tips and warnings {.unnumbered}
- Linear function because it plots a line
- Don't rush, project
- Changing scale can change quantitative visual (changin x axis)
- x = 0 intersection with, only one
- intersection with y = 0 are solution to f(x) = 0
- maximum, inflexion, minimum, increasing, decreasing, you can just look at that in the figure.
- Just plot and you are good to go.
- You can make figures with discrete x, see @sec-difference, @sec-discrete_continuous, @sec-pmf,
